verdict.rationale: Modal publishes its own SDK API reference pages, such as the Sandbox, Probe and SandboxSnapshot references. It also publishes example code users can run themselves, including a full LLM coding-agent example and JS/Go snippets with exec calls. That covers a reference with runnable examples in a static form. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser execution, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: interactive in-docs API explorer, in-browser runnable examples, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent corroboration of the docs experience.
